name: lawbar-desktop
description: Lawbar — local-first, offline-first Mac desktop case-box client (v1). Functional case-management UI (matters, documents, deadlines, docket, facts, evidence links, audit trail, 证据目录/说明 T3 preview + DOCX export) over the local case-box persistence layer. Dev build: not yet code-signed or notarized, and public distribution is a pending release (gate-4) decision — not authorized for distribution until then.
